title: Tweaks & Treats
description: A bunch of cool stuff and simple changes
body:
Tons of cool tweaks and treats to test out and just have fun with new features such as new armour, tools, advancements, and recipes :)

- Adds Echorite, crafted from molten netherite and echo shards, which can be turned into Echorite armour and tools

- Allows for raw blocks to be able to be crafted into full blocks, e.g. Raw iron block -> Iron block

- Adds the songs [I Turned 3rd Life Into a Song (feat. all 3rd Lifers)](https://youtu.be/JV2L0NDWvBg), along with the other life series songs be Evil Anvil. (I do not own the rights to these songs. The rights belong to [Evil Anvil](https://www.youtube.com/@Evil_Anvil).)
